content:
alex: Quick sync — need to finalize metrics & dashboard fields for prefix/kv cache effectiveness before next PM review. Can eng-runtime + infra + console weigh in? Key outputs we want: hit_rate, eviction_rate, reuse_by_workload, warm_fraction, median_kv_ttl. Also tenant vs global breakdowns. Thoughts?
sophia: From runtime: +1. reuse_by_workload should be computed at request-prefix level (model+route+prefix_hash). We'll emit two counters: prefix_requests_total and prefix_hits_total. reuse = hits/requests over a sliding window. Sampling OK for high-cardinality prefixes.
leo: Infra note: cardinality is the killer. Avoid raw_prefix labels. Use prefix_bucket (sha1->first6) or hashed_prefix_dim. We'll keep 30d retention for aggregated metrics, 7d for raw debug dumps. :warning: Evictions must be emitted as events + a counter (prefix_evictions_total) so eviction_rate = evictions / requests.
jamie: Console needs per-route and per-model filters and overlay for rollout % so PMs can correlate reuse with rollout. We need model_version and route_id tags on the metrics. Also need an anomaly signal: sudden drop in reuse_by_workload > 20% to surface in the rollout UX.
rachel: From product: make dashboards traffic-weighted (so big tenants show) and add an estimated cost_savings metric: tokens_saved_est * avg_cost_per_token. That helps in feature reviews and backlog prioritization.
sophia: Implementation plan: runtime will push OpenMetrics counters and also write structured messages to kafka topic `cache-signals` with proto {prefix_hash, model, route, hits, requests, evictions, ts}. We can include sampled raw_prefix payloads for top prefixes.
leo: Infra can consume kafka, compute aggregations and feed the metrics pipeline. We should also compute aggregated daily reuse_by_workload to reduce query load. We'll add sampling for low-volume tenants.
jamie: UI asks: can we also expose a derived `warmth` gauge per prefix (decays with time_since_last_miss) + a heatmap of prefix reuse distribution. For performance, limit heatmap to top 200 prefixes per model. :eyes:
alex: Action items: sophia -> post proto schema by EOD; leo -> propose retention & cardinality limits; jamie -> mock dashboard tiles (route/model filters + rollout overlay); rachel -> define alert thresholds (e.g., reuse drop, eviction spike). Sync Thu 10:00. @sophia @leo @jamie @rachel
kb-metrics-bot: Auto: created tracking ticket RF-4722 and doc https://redwood.internal/docs/kv-cache-metrics-draft — link PRs to RF-4722 please.
sophia: Posted proto snippet in thread: ```message CacheSignal { string prefix_hash = 1; string model = 2; string route = 3; uint64 requests = 4; uint64 hits = 5; uint64 evictions = 6; int64 ts_ms = 7; }``` Will add `sampled_raw_payload` flag for debug dumps.
leo: One more infra detail: eviction counts should include `reason` tag (oom|capacity|ttl) and we should keep top-prefix raw samples for 7d only. I'll add configs in RF-4722.
jamie: I'll drop a quick Figma mock and a minimal API shape: `GET /api/metrics/cache?start=&end=&group_by=model,route&top_prefixes=200`. Will attach to ticket.
alex: :thumbsup: thanks team. Keep comments here — we'll do the Thu sync and lock the final metric names/labels then.
